verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature for launching several attempts of the same task in parallel and comparing them side by side before picking one. Cloning a thread ("work on a copy") and switching models mid-conversation are sequential, adjacent features. Scripting several headless `runMC` invocations would be a developer building block or user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
